mark: Marks are stamped part tags: square with the register's chamfer pair cut outwards past the box, a bright tool edge on top and engraved Martian Mono letters. A pattern mark is laser-etched on bare metal (dark cells on the colour). The current mark has a bare-metal ring cut inside its chamfer; the corner glyph is a small square. Look for the cut corners and the engraved letters.
stackbar: One bar of metal with parts cut from it: the track is a pocket with the carbon weave and a chamfered end, parts have a bright tool edge along their top, and the seams are milled grooves. Pointing at a part turns its tool edge to bare bright metal at once; the legend swatches are chamfered chips. A failed read is a plate with a bronze edge along its top.
bullets: The bar is titanium's heat-tinted groove meter. The figure is Martian Mono; a figure past its limit is a plate with the chamfer pair. A row that leads somewhere shows a bare-metal bar on its start edge under the pointer, instantly, and drops 1 px when pressed.
tick: A changed count runs in one cut of 240 ms; digits keep their width, nothing flares or glows. The tile is titanium's machined key-figure plate.
uptime: The strip is machined slats in a milled pocket with the carbon weave: unlit slats are the pocket's dark ground, lit slats have a bright tool edge along their top. The pointed slat grows and gets a bare-metal tool edge at once (60 ms, linear). Title and figures are Martian Mono, the quick info is the register's popover cut open from the top.
uptime-states: Loading is the anodising bath: the oxide colours drift start to end over the slats with the busy card in the middle; empty and failed keep the strip's height, the failed summary a plate with the tool edge.
uptime-phone: At phone width the strip keeps its pocket, the title and the share stay on one line, the scrolling variant fades its far end, and the busy card fits the frame.
inbox: Rows are separated by milled grooves. A row's state is a bar cut along its start edge: bare metal for new, blue oxide for in flight, gold for a reservation, bronze for a failure. The next-up row has a bare-metal tool edge along its top. The buttons are titanium's own: chamfered, instant, 1 px drop on a press.
backlog: The same rows, the job's payload folded into a milled pocket (dark ground, shadow inside its top edge, Martian Mono). Group headings are engraved mono with a groove under them; the pressed row button shows the facing cut and keeps its width.
files: File rows with the format in the lead as an engraved mono tag, milled grooves between rows, buttons cut with the chamfer pair; a missing file's row has the bronze bar along its start edge.
appointments: A list of days: the day in engraved mono over the hour, the next one with a bare-metal tool edge along its top on a muted plate, past ones quieter by ink. Group headings are mono with a groove under them.
checks: Machined rows with the chamfer pair and a tool edge. A warning is a gold tool edge along the top (the oxide's first heat), a failure a bronze one; the fix written out has a bare-metal bar on its start edge, an instruction rather than an aside. A loading row is in the anodising bath.
sort: The sorted header carries the tool edge in bare metal along its top, at once and linear; pressing any sortable header drops it 1 px; the arrow is Martian Mono; a column that cannot be sorted has no mark and no pointer.
kv: Labels are engraved Martian Mono (a dark cut over a lit lip); values keep the body face. Rows with lines are divided by a milled groove, a changed value carries a small square mark in bare metal, a row that could not be read has a 3 px bronze bar in the gap.
formrows: Labels are engraved mono, rows divided by milled grooves; a changed row has a 3 px bar of bare metal in its gap, a failed row a bronze one. At phone width the aside moves under the control so a label in Martian Mono's wide cells never runs into it.
tiles: Each choice is a machined plate with the chamfer pair and the weave; pointing turns its tool edge to bare metal; ticked, the plate is muted with a bare-metal edge along its top and a hairline all round; a press drops it 1 px. Titles are Martian Mono; the focus ring is cut inside the chamfer.
card-states: The card keeps one footprint: loading is the busy card in the anodising bath with the facing-cut spinner; empty is the empty state's plate; failed is the alert with a normal Try again. Nothing around moves between the four states.
header: The mark is a stamped tag before the title, the freshness line is Martian Mono and ticks without moving anything; the header's keys are titanium's own, with the chamfer pair and a 1 px drop on a press.
art: Six drawings on a machinist's drawing: a blank chamfered plate with its datum cross (none), a plate probed with nothing found (nomatch), a plate fractured through in bronze (error), a bar parted with its gap dimensioned (offline), a finished part with its bore inspected (done), a part under its clasp (locked). Each stroke is cut in from the start edge on titanium's curve and cools from gold through violet and blue to bare metal.
pipeline: Lanes are machined plates with the chamfer pair and the weave; each head is an engraved plate with the stage's oxide as a strip along its top edge, name and count in Martian Mono. A card is a plate that turns its tool edge to bare metal under the pointer and drops 1 px when pressed; the open card has a bare-metal bar on its start edge.
pipeline-states: Loading lays the busy card in the anodising bath with ghost cards in the bath too; empty and failed put a chamfered plate above the lanes, the failed one with a bronze edge along its top.
journey: A rail: the way to come is a dark milled channel with a bright lip, the way travelled is oxide in the step's own colour. Steps are chamfered keys; the step it stands at has a bare-metal ring cut inside its chamfer and a dot. Names are engraved mono, dates Martian Mono.
journey-states: Loading is the anodising bath with the busy card; empty and failed keep the footprint, the failed one with the bronze edge and a normal Retry.
contact: Moments are machined marks (shape and colour keep the kind), a count is a small chamfered plate, a stretch is an oxide wash from start to end, the holiday band is a start-edge rule with a fading wash; pointing turns a mark's ring to bare metal.
contact-states: Loading is the busy card in the bath over ghost lanes; empty and failed fill the plot's footprint with their sentence on a plate.
secret: The value is a pocket in the plate; shown, it is cut in from the start edge on titanium's curve in 240 ms. The countdown is the oxide film cooling away start to end, not a navy rule. A failed read has a 3 px bronze bar and an instruction to retry.
secret-phone: At phone width the value, Reveal and Copy wrap onto their own lines and the line under them keeps its room.
manage: The wide dialog is cut open from the top as titanium's dialogs are; sections are divided by milled grooves with engraved mono headings; the danger section is a chamfered plate with the bronze tool edge along its top.
confirm: What still uses the thing is a milled pocket in Martian Mono; a blocked removal says so and shows no field; the keys are titanium's own and Delete carries the bronze.
type-dialog: The loss list is a chamfered plate with the bronze tool edge along its top; the name to type is an engraved chip in a hairline; the field is titanium's own and the match line says Matched in Martian Mono on the success plate.
type-own: The same block in a page's own dialog: the same plate and engraved chip.
type-phone: At phone width the plate and the field take the full width; the status line keeps its one line of room.
disc: The disc is a turned part: a round face with turning grain (the facing cut's own), twelve marks on the rim, and the time left as a sector of bare metal with grain, round the hub's turned boss. Name in mono; Start and Reset are titanium's keys.
disc-states: Paused dims the sector; ended rings the face in bronze and the line says Time is up in bronze; nothing breathes.
disc-phone: At phone width the disc scales to 70 % of the window at most; name and keys stay centred under it.
countdown: The digits are Martian Mono in a milled pocket on a chamfered plate; running, the pocket has a blue-oxide edge along its foot (the system speaking); every digit keeps its cell so the time never moves the layout.
countdown-states: Paused dims the digits; ended has the bronze tool edge along the card's top and the status in bronze; +1 min restarts; nothing breathes or glows.
range: The presets are titanium's segmented keys; the custom window in force is a muted plate with a bare-metal edge along its top; the window's name is Martian Mono; the panel is the register's popover cut open from its trigger.
range-states: A refused window shows a bronze tool edge on the field and the sentence under it; the panel keeps its height.
wheel: An indexing head: segments in the oxide colours cut apart by dark grooves, a hairline rim, the hub a turned boss with grain, the pointer a bare-metal detent. It settles on titanium's one curve, slowing as it lands with no overshoot. The pick is engraved in Martian Mono.
cook: The count is Martian Mono, the screen line's square lights in blue oxide while the screen stays on, the ingredients are a milled pocket with amounts in Martian Mono, and Back and Next are big chamfered keys with a 1 px press.
timers: A timer is a chamfered plate with the weave; the time is Martian Mono engraved in a pocket, with a blue-oxide edge along its foot while it runs; the bar is titanium's groove meter. A finished timer has the bronze tool edge along its top and a bronze state word; it never breathes.
quantity: Minus and plus are titanium's keys; the figure is Martian Mono in a chamfered pocket with the unit engraved; focus is cut inside the chamfer, a refused word shows a bronze tool edge.
checklist: Rows are divided by milled grooves, group heads and amounts are Martian Mono, a row gets a bare-metal bar on its start edge under the pointer and drops 1 px when pressed; a ticked row is struck through; a failed list has the bronze tool edge.
tri: Each chip is a machined key whose state is a square mark: hollow either way, bare metal filled with a tick for in (with a bare-metal edge along its top), bronze with a cross for out (with the bronze edge and the label struck). The chip never changes width.
code: A block of code is a pocket milled into a chamfered plate: Martian Mono on the dark ground, JSON keys in blue oxide (what the system says), a milled groove under the head, line numbers engraved. A failed block has the bronze edge along its top.
command: The command's head is an engraved plate with the terminal name and the key; the code sits in a pocket with the prompt in blue oxide; where it runs is Martian Mono under a groove.
command-long: A long command wraps under its first character after the prompt or scrolls inside the pocket with its edge faded; the head never moves.
command-phone: At phone width the head keeps one line, the pocket takes the full width and long lines wrap under the prompt.
compare: The divider is a bare-metal parting line with a dark lip; the handle is a turned knob with grain and a 1 px press; labels are chamfered engraved tags; the frame is a chamfered plate. The glide to a press runs 240 ms on titanium's curve.
compare-live: Loading is the busy card in the anodising bath over a quiet plate; a failed image is a plate with the bronze edge along its top and a normal Retry over the visible pane.
